questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word that is pronounced noo-moh-nee-uh?
explanation: Pneumonia is correct - P-N-E-U-M-O-N-I-A. The P is silent. Pneumonia is an infection of the lungs.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced nee?
explanation: Knee is correct - K-N-E-E. The K is silent. Knee is the joint in the middle of the leg.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced rye-t?
explanation: Write is correct - W-R-I-T-E. The W is silent. Write means to form letters or words.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced sa-YKE-oh-luh-jee?
explanation: Psychology is correct - P-S-Y-C-H-O-L-O-G-Y. The P is silent and CH makes a K sound.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced REH-tuh-rik?
explanation: Rhetoric is correct - R-H-E-T-O-R-I-C. The H after R is silent. Rhetoric is the art of persuasive speaking.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced flek-suh-bul?
explanation: Flexible is correct - F-L-E-X-I-B-L-E. The IBLE ending is often confused with ABLE. Flexible means able to bend easily.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced fy-LOS-oh-fee?
explanation: Philosophy is correct - P-H-I-L-O-S-O-P-H-Y. The PH makes an F sound in two places.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced ak-SES?
explanation: Access is correct - A-C-C-E-S-S. Double C and double S. Pronounced ak-SES meaning an approach or entry.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced KOR-us?
explanation: Chorus is correct - C-H-O-R-U-S. The CH makes a K sound. A chorus is a group of singers or the refrain of a song.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced TEK-nik?
explanation: Technic is correct for the pronunciation TEK-nik. More commonly technique - T-E-C-H-N-I-Q-U-E - means a way of accomplishing a task.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced SY-lent?
explanation: Silent is correct - S-I-L-E-N-T. Silent means making no sound. The E in the middle is not pronounced.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced vok-AB-yuh-ler-ee?
explanation: Vocabulary is correct - V-O-C-A-B-U-L-A-R-Y. The vowel sounds in this word are often mispronounced leading to misspelling.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced am-BIG-yoo-us?
explanation: Ambiguous is correct - A-M-B-I-G-U-O-U-S. The UO combination is unusual. The word means open to more than one interpretation.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced SY-nuh-nim?
explanation: Synonym is correct - S-Y-N-O-N-Y-M. The Y in the first syllable makes a short I sound. A synonym is a word with the same meaning.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced kon-SENT-rate?
explanation: Concentrate is correct - C-O-N-C-E-N-T-R-A-T-E. The vowel E in the second syllable is often changed to A in mispronunciation.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced meh-MOR-ee-ul?
explanation: Memorial is correct - M-E-M-O-R-I-A-L. Memorial means relating to the remembrance of someone who has died.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced ek-SPIR-ee-uns?
explanation: Experience is correct - E-X-P-E-R-I-E-N-C-E. The vowel pattern in the middle is often misspelled due to pronunciation.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced es-EN-shul?
explanation: Essential is correct - E-S-S-E-N-T-I-A-L. Double S. The TI makes a SH sound. Essential means absolutely necessary.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced kuh-MYOO-ni-tee?
explanation: Community is correct - C-O-M-M-U-N-I-T-Y. Double M. The unstressed vowels are hard to hear hence the misspelling.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced in-TER-est-ing?
explanation: Interesting is correct - I-N-T-E-R-E-S-T-I-N-G. The middle E is often dropped in casual speech leading to misspelling.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced SOO-perb?
explanation: Superb is correct - S-U-P-E-R-B. Superb means excellent. The EU sound is spelled with U followed by E.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced suh-JES-chun?
explanation: Suggestion is correct - S-U-G-G-E-S-T-I-O-N. Double G. The GG makes a J sound before the E. Suggestion means an idea put forward.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced kuh-REER?
explanation: Career is correct - C-A-R-E-E-R. Double E before R. Career means the progress of a person through their professional life.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced ak-YOOR-it?
explanation: Accurate is correct - A-C-C-U-R-A-T-E. Double C. The CU makes a KY sound. Accurate means correct in all details.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced SER-kuh-ler?
explanation: Circular is correct - C-I-R-C-U-L-A-R. From Latin circulus meaning circle. The unstressed vowels are hard to identify from pronunciation.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced TAY-bul?
explanation: Table is correct - T-A-B-L-E. The AY sound in the first syllable is spelled as A and the UL sound at the end is spelled LE.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced kuh-MYU-ni-KAY-shun?
explanation: Communication is correct - C-O-M-M-U-N-I-C-A-T-I-O-N. Double M. The SH sound at the end is spelled TION.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced EF-ert?
explanation: Effort is correct - E-F-F-O-R-T. Double F. The EF sound is spelled EFF. Effort means physical or mental exertion.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced RI-thum?
explanation: Rhythm is correct - R-H-Y-T-H-M. No vowel letters but the Y acts as a vowel. Rhythm is the pattern of beats in music.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced ak-SEEDS?
explanation: Accedes is correct - A-C-C-E-D-E-S. Double C. To accede means to agree or give consent. The pronunciation sounds similar to exceeds.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced GWAI-erd?
explanation: Guiared is not standard. The intended word is gnarled - G-N-A-R-L-E-D. Gnarled means knobbly and twisted. The G is silent.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word whose first syllable sounds like reck?
explanation: Wreck is correct - W-R-E-C-K. The W is silent. Wreck means to destroy completely.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced EN-vuh-lop?
explanation: Envelope is correct - E-N-V-E-L-O-P-E. The final E is silent. An envelope is a flat paper container for a letter.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced AY-kee-oh-muh?
explanation: Acme is correct - A-C-M-E. Pronounced AK-mee. Acme means the highest point or the peak of achievement.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced KAZ-yoo-ul?
explanation: Casual is correct - C-A-S-U-A-L. The SU makes a ZH sound. Casual means relaxed and informal.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced in-EV-it-uh-bul?
explanation: Inevitable is correct - I-N-E-V-I-T-A-B-L-E. Note ABLE not IBLE. Inevitable means certain to happen.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced SIM-uh-lee?
explanation: Simile is correct - S-I-M-I-L-E. Pronounced SIM-uh-lee. A simile is a figure of speech comparing two things using like or as.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced MET-uh-for?
explanation: Metaphor is correct - M-E-T-A-P-H-O-R. The PH makes an F sound. A metaphor is a figure of speech applying a non-literal description.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced EP-uh-gram?
explanation: Epigram is correct - E-P-I-G-R-A-M. An epigram is a short witty saying. From Greek epigramma meaning inscription.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced MYOO-zi-kul?
explanation: Musical is correct - M-U-S-I-C-A-L. The unstressed vowel A in the final syllable is hard to hear in natural speech.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced TIM-id?
explanation: Timid is correct - T-I-M-I-D. Timid means showing lack of courage. The vowel I appears in both syllables.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced FAR-us?
explanation: Pharaoh is correct - P-H-A-R-A-O-H. The PH makes an F sound and the AOH ending is unusual. Pharaoh was the title of Egyptian rulers.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced FREN-zee?
explanation: Frenzy is correct - F-R-E-N-Z-Y. Frenzy means a state of wild excitement or uncontrolled activity.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced ay-KWIL-uh-bree-um?
explanation: Equilibrium is correct - E-Q-U-I-L-I-B-R-I-U-M. From Latin aequilibrium meaning equal balance. Means a state of balance.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced SY-MUL-TAY-nee-us?
explanation: Simultaneous is correct - S-I-M-U-L-T-A-N-E-O-U-S. Means occurring or done at the same time. The EOUS ending is easily misspelled.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word whose silent letter pattern is WR?
explanation: Wrinkle is correct - W-R-I-N-K-L-E. The W is silent. Wrinkle means a small line or fold in the skin or on a surface.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced HYOO-mur-us?
explanation: Humorous is correct - H-U-M-O-R-O-U-S. The OU is silent. Do not add extra U. Humorous means funny or amusing.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced uh-PROH-pree-it?
explanation: Appropriate is correct - A-P-P-R-O-P-R-I-A-T-E. Double P. The IA combination is often misspelled. Appropriate means suitable.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced puh-RAN-oid?
explanation: Paranoid is correct - P-A-R-A-N-O-I-D. From Greek paranoia meaning madness. Paranoid means having an irrational suspicion of others.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the word pronounced KAHR-ee-kuh-chur?
explanation: Caricature is correct - C-A-R-I-C-A-T-U-R-E. From Italian caricare meaning to load. An exaggerated portrayal or description.
